title: Bath & Body Works Beats Q3 Estimates, but CEO Daniel Heaf Says There’s More Work to Do
summary: Bath & Body Works exceeded third-quarter sales and earnings expectations and showcased early progress from its Consumer First Formula strategy. But Heaf emphasized the need for further improvements to drive sustainable growth across all channels.
